name: anudeep-khadi-bandar-billing
description: fix(ledger-sync): set Supabase as exclusive primary source for IM.fetchInvoices, isolate secondary REST sync, and sync master repository ledger
releaseNotes: 1. IM.fetchInvoices now queries Supabase Cloud directly first to prevent outdated GAS from clearing newly generated bills. 2. Continuous 2-second poller skips secondary REST call when Supabase is active. 3. Synchronized GitHub master ledger with Supabase records.
